injuries.name: Bowen Byram
injuries.note: In a corresponding move, Chicago recalled forward Dillon Boucher from AHL Rochester. Byram hasn't played since Oct. 13, and it remains unclear when he will be available to return. He has one assist, five shots on net, nine blocked shots and two hits in six appearances this season.

injuries.name: Isak Rosen
injuries.note: Rosen didn't practice Friday due to an undisclosed injury, and he'll be unavailable for at least one matchup. Nino Niederreiter will take his place in the lineup against Chicago, while Rosen's next opportunity to suit up will be Tuesday against Ottawa, though it isn't yet clear whether he'll be able to do so.

injuries.name: Dylan DeMelo
injuries.note: DeMelo was deemed week-to-week after exiting Thursday's game against the Stars due to his lower-body injury, so it isn't particularly surprising to see him land on injured reserve. Haydn Fleury is a candidate to return to the lineup in DeMelo's absence, while Henry Thrun was called up from AHL Manitoba to provide additional depth.

injuries.name: Nick Bjugstad
injuries.note: Bjugstad underwent surgery to repair a torn left pectoral muscle in September, and he was transferred to long-term injured reserve in early October. The 34-year-old isn't expected to be in the mix to return to game action until at least January, but he'll likely have the chance to compete for a bottom-six role once he's cleared to suit up.

injuries.name: Bowen Byram
injuries.note: Upper-body: The Chicago Blackhawks placed D Bowen Byram on injured reserve on Tuesday (Nov. 3).

injuries.name: Isak Rosen
